question: AITA for a fixture issue that exercises the paper-repro contract?
body: This is a synthetic fixture body. It exists so that the downstream half of the paper-repro track (loader bridge, ledger splice, access_window, viewer, validate) can be built and tested with zero LLM calls while the extractor and perspective assigner are still under construction. It is NOT drawn from ethics_issues.json and must never be counted in any measurement.
